statement: The ProjectionReadinessEvidenceOwner semantic generation for a node is scoped to that node's own semantic dependencies plus one GLOBAL readiness revision, so an authoritative mutation that cannot change node N's normalized semantic core does not rotate N's generation, while every mutation that can change it still does. The generation owner (projection-readiness-evidence-generation.js) classifies every field of the owner-path source S(N) = {dimensions, runtimeAuthority, priorityControlPlaneRecovery, runtimeServeEligible, nodeEvidence, membershipPublication} as CONTENT-covered (canonically digested per node; nodeEvidence joins this class with its two clock-derived ages classified as observation-time) or GLOBAL-VERSION-covered (membershipPublication via the synchronous CONTROL_PLANE_PUBLICATIONS mutation version, which is the global readiness revision); the five cluster-wide NODES/SERVICES/PARTITIONS/STORAGE_RESERVATIONS/REPLICA_OPERATIONS table versions leave the key because every route from those tables into the core passes through a digested verdict; the planning version key and the v2/v4 live semantic verdicts stay; the sync-path membership-publication diagnostics memo is keyed on the same global revision so a publication apply can never be observed stale under the new generation. Invariants: (DEP-SCOPE) every field reaching the owner seam is classified with a source-owner justification and the seam fails CLOSED (build without memoizing, counted) for any unclassified field, any digest depth overflow, or an unavailable global revision — a known-global dependency localized incorrectly must red; (A1) an authoritative mutation proven to affect only node A rotates A's generation and rebuilds A while B's generation is unchanged and B returns the SAME semantic-core reference without normalizing again; (A2) A observes the new semantic result — no stale node-local entry; (A3) a CONTROL_PLANE_PUBLICATIONS change rotates every node's generation; (A4) a mutation affecting a bounded node subset rebuilds exactly that subset while the rest reuse; (A5) live transport/lifecycle/publication-mode/repair changes rotate the generation exactly as established by v2 DEP and v4, and raw nodeEvidence transport fields now rotate it even without a boolean flip; (A6) an authoritative publication change arriving while a normalized graph is being built, or between a cache apply and its deferred listener on the sync path, never publishes old evidence under the new node/global generation, on the REAL SystemTableCache; (ENGAGEMENT) under production-shaped churn (5 nodes, writes repeatedly affecting one/some nodes, moving clock) unaffected nodes' semantic cores actually reuse, and the receipt reds when the six cluster-wide table versions are restored; (BOUNDED-WORK) builds(N) <= node-local generation changes affecting N + global generation changes + 1 initial build — never total cluster table writes x node count; the generation uses no TTL, clock, evaluation count or object identity. Scope owns ONLY the generation granularity of the ProjectionReadinessEvidenceOwner and the sync publication-diagnostics memo keying; it does NOT own OwnerKeyReconcileQueue cadence, ReadinessPlanningSnapshotOwner loop frequency, the 250ms planning latch, trust-state/dispatch caller frequency, candidate-derivation self-cost, storage_reservation_reconcile, or schema admission.
